# Implement one AeroPulse story

Implement the attached or described GitHub issue/user story only.

Before editing:

1. read `.github/copilot-instructions.md`;
2. read `docs/architecture/repository-structure.md`;
3. read relevant ADRs;
4. inspect affected code and existing tests;
5. restate the acceptance criteria.

Then provide:

## Needs

What business/technical requirement must be satisfied?

## Plan

Give the smallest implementation sequence.

## Risks

Identify meaningful business, data-integrity, security, concurrency, reliability, compatibility, and architecture risks.

## Mitigations

Explain how the implementation/tests address them.

## Implementation

Implement only the required change.

Rules:

- preserve domain/framework boundaries;
- do not add speculative abstractions;
- do not introduce unrelated dependencies;
- add/update relevant tests;
- do not silently refactor unrelated files.

## Validation

Run all currently configured applicable deterministic checks.

At the end report:

- files changed;
- acceptance criteria satisfied;
- tests/checks and results;
- unresolved risks/follow-ups.

Do not claim a command was run if it was not executed.
